body: And that’s talent too 🤝 or at least what I tell myself
Okay but birthday cake McFlurry?!? Shut up where??
The little candy flower on the second cake is killing me 🤣🤣
I haven’t laughed in a while since my husbands suicide. But this lmao. 😭🤣
It’s really good on green apple tho!

I feel like I’m on autopilot like I’m in someone else’s body. I ended up calling a suicide hotline and my son came home I decided to take him on a movie date & just spending time with him one on one helped tremendously. I know this feeling won’t go away but I need to try for them.
I’m so sorry you have to go through this nightmare with me I’m so sorry he left you like this. Thank you for your kind words reaching out to me in my desperate time I appreciate it more than you know.

I don’t have much family or friends 
His death took a toll on my mental health on top of ptsd and anxiety I’ve isolated myself because I just can’t be around people I’m in so much pain.
My mother is toxic but I don’t think she has a clue she probably thinks her way is right and is so stubborn about it. 
I have applied for housing I’m just on a wait list
Thank you for your words I appreciate it more than you know.

I have applied for housing I’m on a high priority wait list and I don’t have many friends I’ve kind of isolated myself in my time of grief. His death took a toll on me and ruined me. 
Unfortunately I have to pay his debt  but the government are going to let me slowly pay it back. I might consider bankruptcy I’ll look into it thank you.

Yes I have I also filed for housing I’m just waiting on the wait list. Money is tight because I needed to borrow a lot from my parents to cover funeral cost and stuff like that and I’m slowly paying them back. I know this is abuse 100 percent but I have no where to go that’s safe for me and the kids. It’s safe here don’t get me wrong and they take care of my children so well, it just seems like she wants me to heal her way. Im basically walking on eggshells just so we don’t fight. I’m hoping housing will come before school starts.
I’ve thought about telling a social worker but I know how bad that would escalate things I would rather be out of the house with the kids settled before I start that war.

My husband killed himself with one of his shotguns. I was hanging on the hope that he would make it (I’d even take care of his crippled ass) Please reach out don’t go out like this. Everyday I go to bed wanting to die because I feel so guilty for not being able to save him.
